videos.title: Grand Tours of the Scottish Islands
videos.description: Paul journeys around the coast of the Long Island of Harris and Lewis, beginning on Scarp, travelling north to Great Bernera, then south-east to Scalpay. These islands may seem to exist in the shadow of their much larger neighbours, but Paul discovers they have a distinct identity all of their own, as he hears remarkable stories of crofter rebellions, rocket mail and a rich local culture.

videos.title: Ancient Megacities
videos.description: The Phoenicians built Carthage, a grand city at Mediterranean trade crossroads, in the 9th century BC. After the Third Punic War, Rome took over, leaving Hadrian with the responsibility to ensure year-round water supply.

videos.title: Hitler's Power
videos.description: This episode is about Hitler being able to establish a 'Führer state' so quickly. After his appointment as chancellor in 1933, he set about breaking down democracy and establishing a totalitarian dictatorship.

videos.title: The Truth about Franco: Spain's Forgotten Dictatorship
videos.description: At the end of a bloody civil war, Francisco Franco seized power and ruled Spain with an iron hand for nearly four decades. Under his leadership the conservative, monarchist armed forces staged a coup against Spain's republican government which had been democratically elected. The insurrection was supported by Italy and Germany. Three years of bitter civil war followed which, by April 1939, had turned Spain into a different country. The hostilities and political purges cost half a million lives.
